bounded.membership: origin_x <= x < origin_x + width and origin_y <= y < origin_y + height
bounded.arithmetic: validate endpoints in signed-64-bit before commit

invalid: negative legacy dimensions cannot enter canonical create or resize
unbounded with nonzero origin width or height
endpoint outside the int32 coordinate domain plus one exclusive endpoint

legacy_extent_characterization.setters: field-only update that preserves cells outside the new bounds
legacy_extent_characterization.migration: only nonnegative finite extents and the canonical 0x0 unbounded form migrate directly; mixed-unbounded and negative forms remain legacy-only

canonical_neighbor_order.filtering: preserve relative order after bounds blocked and corner-policy filtering

legacy_neighbor_order.compatibility: legacy owned-list functions retain this order in ABI 1.x

diagonal_policies.orthogonal_evaluation: use the same effective blocked query as destination evaluation
diagonal_policies.failure: any destination or orthogonal callback failure aborts the whole query and preserves outputs

degree_and_goal_selection.candidate_set: canonical neighbor order for the configured topology after bounds filtering
degree_and_goal_selection.blocked_filter: degree and goal selection are topology-only unless the operation explicitly requests traversable-only
degree_and_goal_selection.NAVGRID_DIR_4: only E S W N are candidates; never index the first four entries of an 8-direction table

cell_model.absent: no sparse-map entry; implicit NORMAL height 0 base cell
cell_model.explicit_default: present NORMAL height 0 entry; traversal-equivalent to absent but observably present to cell queries
cell_model.base_forbidden: present FORBIDDEN terrain and blocked by the built-in policy
cell_model.block_overlay: separate provenance-bearing blocked layer that does not overwrite the base cell
cell_model.unblock: remove only the selected overlay source and reveal the remaining overlays or base cell
cell_model.traversal_cost: navgrid assigns no cost; a route-finder default callback may return 1.0 independently of terrain
cell_model.custom_callback: when bound it replaces the built-in blocked interpretation and is authoritative for every inside coordinate
cell_model.unknown_terrain: reject normal mutation; raw corrupt entries are blocked conservatively

status_matrix.inside_absent: NAVSYS_STATUS_OK with presence=absent and implicit default cell

coordinate_query_result.failure_output: preserve the complete caller output on every non-OK status

caller_buffer_queries.query: out buffer NULL with capacity 0 returns required count
caller_buffer_queries.short_buffer: INCOMPLETE writes required count and preserves the payload buffer
caller_buffer_queries.success: writes the complete deterministic result and actual count
caller_buffer_queries.invalid_combination: NULL with nonzero capacity or non-NULL with zero capacity is INVALID_ARGUMENT
caller_buffer_queries.neighbor_order: canonical E S W N or E SE S SW W NW N NE with filtering preserving relative order
caller_buffer_queries.cell_order: ascending coord.x then coord.y over the base-cell and overlay-coordinate union
caller_buffer_queries.cell_blocked_field: built-in base FORBIDDEN or overlay state; custom callbacks cannot enumerate arbitrary coordinates
caller_buffer_queries.allocation: native caller-buffer query paths perform no library allocation
caller_buffer_queries.legacy_adapter: owned-return functions retain caller destroy ownership and forward through the checked query core

canonical_resize.coordinate_identity: stored coordinates remain absolute when origin changes
canonical_resize.shrink_or_origin_shift: atomically remove base cells and overlays outside the new half-open extent
canonical_resize.expand: preserve all existing inside cells and expose no previously clipped cells
canonical_resize.to_unbounded: preserve every current cell and overlay
canonical_resize.from_unbounded: clip to the new bounded extent
canonical_resize.binding_and_topology: preserve callback binding direction mode and diagonal policy
canonical_resize.changed: false only when extent and retained storage are unchanged
canonical_resize.failure: validate and prepare before commit; invalid input OOM or callback failure preserves extent cells overlays and outputs
